description: Full-text search over BuildFeed's curated AI/startup/VC YouTube video library. Scores videos by keyword match across title, topics, TLDR summary, channel name, and key takeaways, ranked by relevance (then recency). Use this when the user asks about a specific topic, person, product, or company and you need to find relevant videos with summaries — not when you just want to browse everything (use list_videos for that instead).

category.description: Restrict results to one category: AI, VC, Startup, Product, Design, or Tools.

limit.description: Max results to return (default 20, hard cap 50).

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "Claude agents", "seed fundraising", "Figma design systems".

since.description: Only videos published on or after this ISO 8601 date (reads the archive index).

name: search_videos
